PurposeFounder-level command board for whether named owners are closing strategic commitments, decision follow-through, risk mitigations, executable checks, recovery actions, and live-gate proof across the operating system.
Source ruleUpdate founder decisions, control integrity, matter control, strategic initiatives, plan variance, risk register, executable-check control, adoption readiness, weekly review, monthly review, task records, and linked source records first, then refresh this review.
Founder useDistinguish real owner-led execution from motion that still depends on founder pressure, memory, or same-day rescue.
Protection ruleThis dashboard governs accountability posture only; approved templates, brand assets, and source-record protections stay unchanged.

Accountability Control PostureLink

Control lensCurrent postureFounder readRequired response
Ownership clarityCritical commitments now have visible owners and evidence routes.The main gap is not ownership visibility; it is owner-led follow-through before founder chase.Judge owners on proof movement, not review participation.
Founder rescue exposureOne trust-linked movement path still risks returning to founder at the moment of execution.A founder rescue is useful once, but repeated rescue is accountability evidence.Convert repeated rescue into owner accountability, adoption drift, or plan variance language.
Follow-through speedSeveral commitments are progressing, but some proof dates still need tighter escalation.Slow proof is not neutral when it affects cash, release, sourcing, or forecast confidence.Time-box commitments with owner, date, source route, and escalation trigger.
Cross-layer consistencyThe same commitments now appear across initiative, variance, risk, cash, and routing boards.If the same issue drifts across multiple layers, the owner path needs pressure.Use this board as the accountability index for recurring cross-layer drift.
Live-gate behaviorExecutable-check discipline is the hardest owner-led proof point.Strategy sync is not success unless owners close the live gate without renewed founder lift.Require task-record and executable-check closure before movement is counted as done.
